# Page title: Example: Configuring Security Zones and Policies for SRX Series - Technical Documentation - Support - Juniper Networks
# Source type: documentation
# Documentation set (page metadata): junos12.1x46 (URL path)
# Junos release shown: not stated
# Retrieved: 2026-10-06
# Assumptions: HIER-1 (hierarchical format)
# Note: Three samples: 'show security zones security-zone DMZ' and 'show security policies from-zone X to-zone Y' (output relative to the path in the command).
# Note: The page renders the sample as nested <span> blocks with a left margin per level: the text is copied as published, indentation rebuilt as 4 spaces per level.
# ---
[edit]
user@srx210-host# show security zones security-zone DMZ
address-book {
    address Server-HTTP-1 192.168.2.2/24;
    address Server-HTTP-2 192.168.2.3/24;
    address Server-SMTP 192.168.2.4/24;
    address-set DMZ-address-set-http {
        address Server-HTTP-1;
        address Server-HTTP-2;
    }
}
    interfaces {
        ge-0/0/1.0 {
            host-inbound-traffic {
                system-services {
                    all;
                }
            }
        }
    }
[edit]
user@srx210-host# show security policies from-zone trust to-zone DMZ
policy permit-mail-trust-DMZ {
    match {
        source-address PC-Trust;
        destination-address Server-SMTP;
        application junos-smtp;
    }
    then {
        permit;
    }
}
[edit]
user@srx210-host# show security policies from-zone DMZ to-zone DMZ
policy permit-http-in-DMZ {
    match {
        source-address DMZ-address-set-http;
        destination-address DMZ-address-set-http;
        application junos-http;
    }
    then {
        permit;
    }
}
